name: Vía Plaza
summary: Vía Plaza is a well-rated community shopping center in San Luis Río Colorado, Sonora, conveniently located near the airport and U.S. border. Part of the Coppel-operated Vía Plaza network, it serves as a key retail destination for local residents and cross-border shoppers with daily operating hours from 9:30 AM to 10:00 PM.
demographics: Vía Plaza Aeropuerto serves the border community of San Luis Río Colorado, attracting a diverse mix of middle-income Mexican families and cross-border shoppers from Arizona. The trade area consists primarily of young to middle-aged adults (25-54) with moderate household incomes who value convenient access to retail and services. Typical visitors include local residents seeking everyday shopping needs, as well as cross-border consumers taking advantage of the plaza's proximity to the international airport and border crossing, creating a unique binational customer base with preferences for both Mexican and American retail brands.
description: Vía Plaza is a modern shopping center located in the Aeropuerto district of San Luis Río Colorado, Sonora, strategically positioned near the U.S.-Mexico border. As part of the Vía Plaza network of commercial plazas operated by Coppel, this center serves as a vital retail hub for the local community and cross-border shoppers. The plaza operates daily from 9:30 AM to 10:00 PM, offering convenient access to a variety of retail stores, services, and dining options. With a strong 4.6-star rating from 89 reviews, Vía Plaza has established itself as a trusted shopping destination in this border region. The center's management is committed to creating "un lugar para sonreír" (a place to smile) and "una vía llena de emociones" (a path full of emotions), reflecting their dedication to providing an enjoyable shopping experience for all visitors.
